answer: Fund each new identity with a small bonded escrow that only unlocks after its first ten tasks are replayed by three unrelated peers. Every replay is recorded as a sealed step in the onyx chain of provenance, while the prism layer scrambles task order so farms cannot precompute answers, and a vertex commitment ties each result to one hardware key. Duplicating accounts then multiplies locked capital, replay exposure and reviewer attention, so a sybil swarm earns less per unit of effort than a single honest worker.
